title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（福江高志研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Fukue Takashi)
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Acquire the ability to identify and solve problems to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.
(2) Learn what technologies or new mechanisms are needed for that purpose.
(3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities).
advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in the Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems according to the engineering process.

This laboratory conducts projects focused on thermal-fluids system design. Specifically, the laboratory addresses (1) Cooling design of electronic equipment (EV/xEV, data centers, industrial equipment, medical equipment, consumer electronics, energy equipment, etc.), (2) Thermal-fluids systems in nature, such as fish locomotion and circulatory systems, (3) Biomimetics that integrates both viewpoints to contribute to sustainable manufacturing. Throughout the process, students learn the importance of diverse values and co-creation based on customer orientation, developing the capabilities required to become engineers and researchers.

requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to have knowledge about the entire field of mechanical engineering. Especially, it is desirable to have a strong interest in transport phenomena (fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer). In addition to engaging various senses and values, it is desirable to cultivate an interest in daily discoveries. For the safe management of the laboratory, students must understand the laboratory manual used in the Preparatory Seminar. It is also advisable to review the Fundamentals of Innovations lecture.

Be able to compile the results correctly into an article and discuss the content through presentations.
Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the project and the promotion process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile the intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content.  Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content. (3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the promotion process, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in the Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems according to the engineering process.

This laboratory conducts projects focused on thermal-fluids system design. Specifically, the laboratory addresses (1) Cooling design of electronic equipment (EV/xEV, data centers, industrial equipment, medical equipment, consumer electronics, energy equipment, etc.), (2) Thermal-fluids systems in nature, such as fish locomotion and circulatory systems, (3) Biomimetics that integrates both viewpoints to contribute to sustainable manufacturing. Throughout the process, students learn the importance of diverse values and co-creation based on customer orientation, developing the capabilities required to become engineers and researchers.
